clinic_working_hours_valid_state.name: clinic_working_hours_valid_state
clinic_working_hours_valid_state.value:
(
        "clinic_working_hours"."is_working"
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."open_minute" IS NOT NULL
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."close_minute" IS NOT NULL
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."open_minute" >= 0
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."close_minute" <= 1440
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."open_minute" < "clinic_working_hours"."close_minute"
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."open_minute" % 15 = 0
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."close_minute" % 15 = 0
      ) OR (
        NOT "clinic_working_hours"."is_working"
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."open_minute" IS NULL
        AND "clinic_working_hours"."close_minute" IS NULL
      )

appointment_requests_open_per_appointmen.name: appointment_requests_open_per_appointment_idx
appointment_requests_open_per_appointmen.where: status = 'pending' AND appointment_id IS NOT NULL

appointment_requests_preferred_matches_k.name: appointment_requests_preferred_matches_kind
appointment_requests_preferred_matches_k.value:
CASE "appointment_requests"."kind"
        WHEN 'cancel' THEN "appointment_requests"."preferred_date" IS NULL AND "appointment_requests"."preferred_start_minute" IS NULL
        WHEN 'reschedule' THEN "appointment_requests"."preferred_date" IS NOT NULL AND "appointment_requests"."preferred_start_minute" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE ("appointment_requests"."preferred_date" IS NULL) = ("appointment_requests"."preferred_start_minute" IS NULL)
      END

appointment_requests_note_when_no_time.name: appointment_requests_note_when_no_time
appointment_requests_note_when_no_time.value: "appointment_requests"."kind" <> 'new' OR "appointment_requests"."preferred_date" IS NOT NULL OR "appointment_requests"."note" IS NOT NULL
